import sys
from operator import ne


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    s = data[0]
    n = len(s)
    half = n // 2
    # pair position i with n-1-i and count the mismatched pairs
    m = sum(map(ne, s[:half], s[::-1][:half]))
    if m % 2 == 0:
        print(m // 2)
    elif n % 2 == 1:
        print((m + 1) // 2)
    else:
        print(-1)


main()
